items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...That's a good picture of Preston in there. Johnny Lindsay.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, and Steiner too. He's another one that's very hard to catch when it comes time to pay up. Yeah, you can't call him. They like all the good stuff, but they don't like to pay for it.

Yeah. I've written to Steiner, but he never replied. No, he's an asshole. That's good. And do you know Paul Gallant? No, I don't know Paul. I've written to him. I would like to see him. That's a good picture of Preston in there. Johnny Lindsay. You are mostly interested in jazz? Yeah. Well, Shaghi, let's come back to Alan Shaw. Could you tell me the story again? Alan Shaw was Peter Weistraugh.
That's right. He was. That was his name.
